query: WITH scope_tracks(track_id) AS ( SELECT entity_id FROM user_library WHERE user_id = ? AND entity_kind = 'track' UNION SELECT entity_id FROM user_feedback WHERE user_id = ? AND entity_kind = 'track' AND value = 'like' UNION SELECT pt.track_id FROM playlist_tracks pt JOIN playlists p ON p.id = pt.playlist_id WHERE p.owner_user_id = ? AND p.is_temporary = 0 UNION SELECT mf.track_id FROM media_files mf JOIN library_folders lf ON lf.id = mf.folder_id WHERE mf.storage = 'folder' AND lf.owner_user_id = ? ) SELECT count(*) AS counted FROM artists ar WHERE ar.id IN (SELECT ta.artist_id FROM track_artists ta JOIN scope_tracks st ON st.track_id = ta.track_id) OR ar.id IN (SELECT aa.artist_id FROM album_artists aa WHERE aa.album_id IN ( SELECT t.album_id FROM tracks t JOIN scope_tracks st ON st.track_id = t.id)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_library WHERE user_id = ? AND entity_kind = 'artist' AND entity_id = ar.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_feedback WHERE user_id = ? AND entity_kind = 'artist' AND value = 'like' AND entity_id = ar.id)
